title: Frontage increase.
officialText: When a building has more than twenty-five per cent of the total perimeter of the building fronting directly upon a street or frontage space, the tabular areas listed in tables 4-1 and 4-2 may be increased 1.33 per cent for each one per cent of such excess frontage.
